hotels.title: Adults-Only Vanuatu Beachfront Bliss with All-Inclusive Dining, Massages & Island Excursions
hotels.description: This beachfront boutique retreat invites you to reconnect with nature by the Pacific Ocean. Home to just nine couples at a time, each traditionally designed room and villa sits on the sandy shores of Espiritu Santo - one of Vanuatu’s most spectacular islands - just steps from the archipelago's brilliant blue waters. The resort offers once-in-a-lifetime excursions included in your stay (subject to resort schedule) - become spellbound by the beauty of Santo's Blue Holes, visit the local market with the resort’s chef, kick back on Champagne Beach's postcard-worthy sands and more. Savour the flavours of the South Pacific with breakfast, lunch and dinner crafted by the talented chef using the freshest local ingredients. Between meals, glide across the shimmering waters on a kayak or paddleboard and snorkel along the magical underwater world just offshore.
